title: Scalable Storage CEu
description: Small storage mod for GTCEu, adding a multiblock for storage.
body:
Scalable Storage CEu is a small mod which adds 1 multiblock to GTCEu- the Scalable Storage Silo. It can store blocks or items of 1 type, similar to a Storage Drawer.

It saves data so long as the controller isn't broken, It can wallshare inputs to act as a 2x2 or even 4x2 storage unit.

It also has a 2 types of upgrades, one for storage and one for voiding.

Storage Upgrades in this mod are unique as they have durability. If the durability runs out, the extra storage will be voided and lost! So it is an automation challenge to keep the upgrades topped up.



In exchange you receieve storage parallel to a super chest at base going all the way to quantum chests, in just HV!

Additionally, it can use ME Hatches and other types of hatches as well as covers to benefit from full GT Logistics.



Made by iristhepianist



All functionalities and specifics of the mod are specified in the Tooltips of the components.
